terms.gloss: call out the names, take the register
terms.grammar: verb phrase: citō, citāre, with nōmina
evidence: Col. 11.1.22: mancipia ergastulī cottīdiē per nōmina citāre (Lewis & Short s.v. citō)
terms.comment: Citāre is to summon by name, as a court calls jurors or a magistrate the senate.

terms.gloss: read out the list of names
evidence: Cic. Dom. 84: in recitandō senātū (Lewis & Short s.v. recitō)

sources: Lewis & Short: cito · Lewis & Short: recito · Lewis & Short: recitatio
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 28, 31, checked against the searchable text of the book.
